notes.title: Patch Note V 1.0.2
notes.notes:
-Fixed a bug where the results screen could cause an error
-Fixed a bug where the Chapter 3 Boss could cause an error
-Adjusted the design of some levels in Chapter 4
-Optimized Russian translation
-Added Steam detection for mini-game score submissions

notes.title: Patch Note V 1.0.1
notes.notes:
-Fixed a bug where some levels were getting stuck inside the terrain.
-Removed the automatic GC mechanism for player maps.
-Fixed a bug where it was difficult to see after the descent platform took effect.
-Added display of apple count after pausing.
-Fixed a bug where the frame rate affected the left and right movement of the balloon platform.
-Fixed an issue where some maps had invisible walls where players could stand.
-Implemented GC mechanism to optimize performance and prevent lag issues during extended gameplay.

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes V0.2
notes.notes:
1. Replaced with entirely new original music.
2. Added various language UI.
3. Fixed the bug where corners of the map might be missing.
4. Fixed an issue where players using controllers might have difficulty jumping when moving downward.
5. Fixed a bug on the flood level where players could die immediately after respawn.

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes V0.1
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bug that changing settings with the mouse did not take effect.
2. Fixed the bug that continuing the game after exiting resulted in progress lost.
3. Reduced the time for the quick restart key to take effect.
4. Added the ability to jump downward on one-way platforms by pressing  ↓ + space.
